Guidance: Model-ready copy of numeric features for ML inference; original raw columns remain unchanged.
Each *_Was_Missing column is 1 when the original value was missing and 0 otherwise. Has_Payment_History=0 means no established payment history.

The *_Model_Input columns use whole-dataset medians for a simple offline/demo fallback. For proper evaluation/training, fit SimpleImputer on the training set only and apply the same fitted pipeline to test and inference data to avoid data leakage.

Store 014 has no established payment history and missing payment features. The imputed values are only placeholders to prevent a NaN crash; the policy must route this store to COD/prepaid/manual review before using the ML prediction.
Credit_Period_Granted_By_Policy remains a deterministic policy output. It is not a training feature for predicting the synthetic Payment_Leniency_Eligible_Target.
